title: Jubilant Juicy Indian Lamb Biryani
description: A salty, cheesy, and aromatic Kashmiri dish featuring ground nutmeg, this lamb biryani is perfect for a monsoon evening. It is a kosher-friendly recipe that serves 6 people.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of ghee in a large pan over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until it is translucent.
Add the ground lamb to the pan and cook until it is browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the ground nutmeg, salt, and black pepper to the pan and stir to combine.
In a large bowl, combine the soaked and drained basmati rice, the cooked lamb mixture, and the shredded mozzarella cheese, and mix well.
In a large saucepan, combine 4 cups of water and 1 tablespoon of ghee, and bring to a boil.
Add the rice and lamb mixture to the saucepan, cover, and reduce the heat to low.
Simmer for 20 minutes, or until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed.
Turn off the heat and let the biryani rest, covered, for 5 minutes.
Fluff the biryani with a fork and serve hot.
